```{r inspect-fisheries-geodatabase}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# Define the location of the original fisheries geodatabase
fisheries_geodatabase_path <- here(
  "data",
  "raw_data",
  "DFO_FisheriesAtlas",
  "Maritimes_Fisheries_Atlas_2019_2023.gdb"
)

# Inspect available spatial layers
fisheries_layer_information <- st_layers(
  fisheries_geodatabase_path
)

# Create a tidy summary
fisheries_layer_summary <- tibble(
  layer_name = fisheries_layer_information$name,
  geometry_type = fisheries_layer_information$geomtype,
  feature_count = fisheries_layer_information$features
)

print(fisheries_layer_summary, n = Inf)
```
